timeline.text: We’ve identified a recent update as a potential source of impact and are conducting further analysis to confirm our hypothesis.

We've isolated that a recent service update removed the "MeetingMessage" traffic subtype from affected messages, causing a lower recipient limit of 25 to be applied instead of the standard 5000. We're rolling back the problematic update for all potentially affected users and have updated the "Title", "User impact", and "Scope of impact" fields of our communications to reflect this change. After further analysis, we've decided to roll back the update for a limited subset of affected service infrastructure and test with affected users to validate if our actions remediated impact prior to initiating a wider roll back. We aim to provide a timeline for the wider roll back to be initiated as soon as possible.

We've completed a rollback of the problematic service update for a limited subset of service infrastructure and validated with affected users that our actions successfully remediated impact. We’re preparing to initiate a wider rollback for all affected users, which we anticipate will begin by our next scheduled update.
